page.overview:
Who is Andrea Kimi Antonelli?

Andrea Kimi Antonelli 'Kimi (born 25 August 2006) is an Italian racing driver currently competing in the Formula 1 for Mercedes. He was a member of the Mercedes Junior Team from 2019 to 2024.

Antonelli is due to race at Mercedes for the alongside George Russell, He will become the first Italian driver in Formula One since Antonio Giovinazzi raced full time in the season.
